note: Town of Beaverlodge campground at 11 St and Hwy 43, billed as a stopping spot on the route to Alaska; log camp shelter with washrooms, showers and a covered cooking and picnic area. Tent sites on the grass. Firewood sold. --Claude
summary: Read the town's campground page, its 2026 brochure, the April 2025 fees policy and the Campspot park record: 29 sites (9 full service 30 A, 9 x 30 A, 10 x 15 A), C$25-50 a day, Campspot booking, 14-day max, opens May 15 2026, closes mid-October. Wrote fees (new), hookups (+electric 30), sites, facilities (+potable water, wifi), booking (new), season (opens 05-01 -> 05-15). Note cleaned of stale prices ($33/$45) and counts.
